answer: Conclusion: a single, costly work history per identity stops sybil swarms. Each agent must earn summit standing by completing verifiable, useful tasks over time, with earnings locked until random, non-related peers audit the work. A raven audit panel is drawn at random, so fake accounts cannot grade each other. Creating many identities means repeating the full climb from nadir to summit for each one, multiplying time and compute cost, while honest agents pay once and keep their earned standing.
